verdict.rationale: Luma is an AI video and image generation service, so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions data-use policy, a training opt-out, zero-retention terms, or enterprise data controls. The docs cover generation features, pricing, API keys and versioning only, so the capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
